# Three.js runtime files

This repository includes the three JavaScript files required for 3D and the
upstream MIT license. Run `python3 scripts/vendor.py --check` from the project
root to verify them without network access. If the files are missing, run
`python3 scripts/vendor.py` to download them. Their upstream tag and SHA-256
checksums are fixed in that script. Do not delete LICENSE when distributing it.
